# Brendan.T — Technical Consultant (brendantwz.com)

> Brendan T. is a Malaysia-based technical consultant for digital spaces. Brendan is a former Intel engineer who now designs systems architecture, conversion optimisation (CRO) and workflow automation for SMEs, service businesses and e-commerce brands. Every engagement starts with a systems audit. Clients are served remotely, worldwide.

Brendan's work targets six problems: the Ghost Business (no authority online), the Leaky Bucket (traffic that doesn't convert), the Invisible Site (no organic search), the Manual Grind (manual lead handling), the Stagnant Store (underperforming e-commerce) and the Ceiling Effect (systems that break at scale).

Contact: brendan@nixlab.my · Request a systems audit: https://brendantwz.com/contact.html

Every page has a Markdown version at the same path with a `.md` extension. Requests sent with `Accept: text/markdown` also get Markdown.
